integrity.proof_scope: Complete symbolic finite-sample ratio proof and first-order large-box covariance limit; exact example verified with integers.
integrity.verification: Independent exact enumeration and rational checker with 13383 passing assertions; finite checks are corroboration only.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes independently uniform allocations to at least three boxes and distinct positive occupancy sizes.
The large-box covariance limit can vanish at isolated load ratios; no sign conclusion is inferred there without higher-order terms.
Classical joint-moment formulas and asymptotic normality are prior knowledge; the claimed contribution is the finite sample-size log-concavity and resulting sign-window classification.
Earlier multivariate classical papers and a related linear-combination paper have not all been available in full text; priority remains provisional.
title: A single covariance window for distinct occupancy frequencies
